description: x.md is a read-only browser for public X content that returns posts, profiles, followers, following, and search results as Markdown or JSON. It mirrors X URLs on mdfromx.com and also offers the same read operations through an MCP server.
summary: mdfromx.com exposes two public integration surfaces: a read-only HTTP API for public X content and a Streamable HTTP MCP server; both are usable without authentication, with an optional manually issued bearer key documented only for increased search allowance.
